en: The tree is wiggling!
It's a weird tree. Use the SquirtBottle on it?
{player} watered the tree with the SquirtBottle!
The tree hated the water! It jumped up and attacked!
Girl
So it was a Pokémon pretending to be a tree! You were so brave. Thank you!
These are from my sister's garden. Please take them.
I'm going back to the flower shop now. Come and see us in Goldenrod sometime!
The strange tree has gone still again...
It's a weird tree. It's wiggling ever so slightly... and it's blocking the way.
This tree won't let anybody past. It wiggles when you touch it! My sister in Goldenrod might know what to do.
That's my sister's SquirtBottle! Go on, give the tree a squirt. I want to see what it does!
Rocks in your way? Smash 'em! That's my motto. Here, take this. You'll know what to do with it.
HM06 is Rock Smash. With the Zephyr Badge, a Pokémon that knows it can break cracked rocks outside of battle.
Sometimes there's a Pokémon hiding under the rock, too!
Smash those rocks! Every rock you break is a rock that can't get in your way.
There's a strange tree blocking the way to Route 37. Nobody can get past it!
The tree that blocked the road turned out to be a Pokémon! Now we can walk to Ecruteak City again.
Arthur
Who are you? I'm Arthur of Thursday. My sisters and brothers each have a day, and Thursday is mine.
A Pokémon that holds a Hard Stone hits harder with Rock-type moves. Thursdays are solid as a rock!
I'm Arthur of Thursday. Did you meet my brothers and sisters? Each of them has a day of their own.
Today isn't Thursday. Come back then.
